verdict.rationale: Pipecat Flows documents functions that interface with external systems and APIs mid-conversation, with metadata auto-derived from the function signature. Its site says long-running tools can be handed off to subagents, which implies non-blocking execution, but nothing explicitly shows the agent avoiding dead air or speaking tool results. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of speaking function results, documented dead-air mitigation such as filler speech or async tool calls, core (non-Flows) LLM function-calling docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Process data by interfacing with external systems and APIs
Flows auto-derives the function's metadata — name, description, parameter properties (with their descriptions), and which parameters are required — from the function's signature and docstring.
Hand off to subagents for long-running tools and complex tasks
